integrity: Universal claim established by a written algebraic proof, with finite standard-library rational checks as illustrative supporting tests only. Prior-art coverage is limited to the named inspected literature and targeted searches; no independent proof or literature audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes strictly positive real block weights and equal finite dimensions with at least two nonempty parts on either side. It does not classify unequal-dimension or complex/mixed-sign cases, and does not resolve the singular-graph conjecture outside complete multipartite graphs.
title: Homomorphism rigidity and weighted classification of real complete-multipartite evolution algebras
